correctness.rationale: Over C the fixed (4,2) map locus has Cox variables of degrees (4,4,2,2,2). Reducing plane containment modulo the two-dimensional span of wv2,wv3 gives a 3-by-2 matrix rank<=1, irreducible codimension two. A real explicit tuple passes the base-point and unramified tests: two 3-by-3 minors are projectively coprime (dehomogenized resultant 1984). Its containing plane pulls back to Bl_p P2; the exact normal sequence has O(8) and O(4) terms and splits by H^1(O(4))=0. General splitting O(6)^2 and exact cohomology give rank 16 generically, rank 14 throughout this locus. The embedded standalone Python program independently reconstructs witness minors and rank 14. Limits: not a classification of the full second jump locus.
